newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Oct trade surplus rises to 248.2 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Oct trade surplus rises to 248.2 mln Sfr.

text.p: Switzerland's trade surplus rose to 248.2 million Swiss francs in October from a revised 115.1 million surplus in September, the Federal Customs Office said.
Note - September surplus was revised from an earlier reported surplus of 121.6 million francs, imports of 7,741.5 million and exports of 7,863.2 million.

The figures above were for all goods except precious metals, precious stones, art objects and antiques. The following figures comprise trade in all goods, including precious metals, precious stones, art objects and antiques.
Note - September surplus was revised from earlier-reported 225.1 million francs, imports 8,114.1 million and exports 8,339.2. -- Zurich Newsroom, +41 1 631 7340
